title: The Chieftain's Horse
offer: My horse Grane will not eat, and he is sad. Bring Tova to look at him, and take her home after.

steps.load_say: Not eating? Let me see his teeth.
steps.say: Tova: Just as I thought: a sore tooth. I file it smooth... There. Let him rest a night.

steps.load_say: Grane eats like a wolf again! Take Tova home, with my thanks.
steps.say: Back on my island. You were good assistants: soon you heal on your own.

fact: Horses' teeth grow all their life; sometimes they must be filed smooth.
